q: 妈妈把钥匙放___桌子上了。
zh: 妈妈把钥匙放在桌子上了。
py: mā ma bǎ yào shi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: Mum put the keys on the table.
why: 放 + 在 + place says where the thing ends up, and the specific object goes in front of the verb with 把. 给 needs a person, 成 a new form and 走 a direction, so none of them fit 桌子上.

q: 请把这个包裹送___我家。
zh: 请把这个包裹送到我家。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè ge bāo guǒ sòng dào wǒ jiā
en: Please deliver this parcel to my home.
why: 送 moves something to a destination, so 到 follows it. 送在 is not a word, and 成 / 作 mean 'turn into' or 'treat as', not 'deliver to'.

q: 姐姐把那件旧毛衣送___了邻居。
zh: 姐姐把那件旧毛衣送给了邻居。
py: jiě jie bǎ nà jiàn jiù máo yī sòng gěi le lín jū
en: My sister gave that old sweater to the neighbour.
why: The neighbour is the person who receives it, so 送给 is needed. 送到了邻居 would need a place word such as 家 after it, and 在 and 成 do not fit a recipient.

q: 他把那张一百块换___了零钱。
zh: 他把那张一百块换成了零钱。
py: tā bǎ nà zhāng yī bǎi kuài huàn chéng le líng qián
en: He changed that hundred-yuan note into small change.
why: 换成 + new form means 'change into'. 给 would need a person, and 作 / 在 do not follow 换 here. The specific note goes before the verb with 把.

q: 奶奶很疼我，一直把我当___自己的亲孙女。
zh: 奶奶很疼我，一直把我当作自己的亲孙女。
py: nǎi nai hěn téng wǒ yī zhí bǎ wǒ dàng zuò zì jǐ de qīn sūn nǚ
en: Grandma dotes on me and has always treated me as her own granddaughter.
why: 当作 means 'treat as' and needs 把 for the person being treated. 当在, 当到 and 当给 are not words.

q: 你把这杯牛奶喝___吧。
zh: 你把这杯牛奶喝了吧。
py: nǐ bǎ zhè bēi niú nǎi hē le ba
en: Drink up this glass of milk.
why: After 把 the verb cannot stand bare, and 喝 has no result here, so 了 is the minimal ending. 着 and 过 do not belong in a 把 command, and leaving the blank empty gives a bare verb.

q: 对不起，我把你的生日忘___。
zh: 对不起，我把你的生日忘了。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bǎ nǐ de shēng rì wàng le
en: Sorry, I forgot your birthday.
why: 忘 is one of the verbs that can end in 了 alone after 把, because the object is lost. A bare 忘 after 把 is incomplete, and 着 does not fit a finished event.

q: 家里放不下了，你把这些旧报纸卖___吧。
zh: 家里放不下了，你把这些旧报纸卖了吧。
py: jiā lǐ fàng bu xià le nǐ bǎ zhè xiē jiù bào zhǐ mài le ba
en: There's no room at home; go and sell these old newspapers.
why: 卖 removes the newspapers, so 了 alone completes the 把 phrase. Without 了 the verb is bare, and 着 / 过 do not make an instruction.

q: 客人马上就到，请你把桌子擦___。
zh: 客人马上就到，请你把桌子擦一下。
py: kè rén mǎ shàng jiù dào qǐng nǐ bǎ zhuō zi cā yī xià
en: The guests are about to arrive; please give the table a wipe.
why: A request with no stated result needs 一下 (or 擦一擦) after the verb. 着, 过 and 的 cannot close a 把 request, and a bare 擦 is not allowed.

q: 妈妈，我___把钥匙带来。
zh: 妈妈，我没把钥匙带来。
py: mā ma wǒ méi bǎ yào shi dài lái
en: Mum, I didn't bring the keys.
why: An event that did not happen is negated with 没, placed before 把. 不 would be used for attitudes, 别 is a command, and 未 is not used in speech.

q: ___把玩具扔在地上！
zh: 别把玩具扔在地上！
py: bié bǎ wán jù rēng zài dì shàng
en: Don't throw your toys on the floor!
why: 'Don't' is 别 (or 不要), and it stands before 把. 没 is for things that did not happen, and 不是 / 不会 do not make commands.

q: 钱不多了，你___把钱花完。
zh: 钱不多了，你不要把钱花完。
py: qián bù duō le nǐ bù yào bǎ qián huā wán
en: There's not much money left; don't spend it all.
why: A warning not to do something uses 不要 before 把. 没 / 没有 report a past non-event, and 已经 would say it has already been spent, which contradicts the English.

q: 我想___这个玩具送给弟弟。
zh: 我想把这个玩具送给弟弟。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè ge wán jù sòng gěi dì di
en: I want to give this toy to my younger brother.
why: 送给 + person with a specific object needs 把 to bring the toy before the verb. 被 would make the toy the actor, and 跟 / 对 do not introduce the thing being given.

q: 我把___块蛋糕吃完了。
zh: 我把那块蛋糕吃完了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà kuài dàn gāo chī wán le
en: I ate up that piece of cake.
why: The object of 把 must be a specific thing, so 那 fits. 一, 两 and 几 introduce new counted objects, which stay after the verb without 把, and they do not match 'that piece'.

q: 爸爸把___旧电视卖了。
zh: 爸爸把家里那台旧电视卖了。
py: bà ba bǎ jiā lǐ nà tái jiù diàn shì mài le
en: Dad sold the old TV we had at home.
why: The 把 object is the identifiable TV, 家里那台. 一台, 几台 and 两台 are counted, new objects, and they would also contradict 'the old TV' in the English.

q: 我把那首歌听___了。
zh: 我把那首歌听完了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà shǒu gē tīng wán le
en: I listened to that song all the way through.
why: 听完 gives a real result, so 把 is fine. 听见 is perception that does nothing to the song and cannot take 把, and 听着 / 听过 are not results.

q: 爸爸把窗户___开了。
zh: 爸爸把窗户打开了。
py: bà ba bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi le
en: Dad opened the window.
why: 把 needs a verb that does something to the window, such as 打开. 喜欢, 知道 and 是 do nothing to their object and never combine with 把.

q: 作业太多了，我今天怎么也做___这些作业。
zh: 作业太多了，我今天怎么也做不完这些作业。
py: zuò yè tài duō le wǒ jīn tiān zěn me yě zuò bu wán zhè xiē zuò yè
en: There's too much homework; I just can't finish this homework today.
why: 做不完 is a potential complement meaning 'cannot get it done', which keeps the object after the verb and never takes 把. 做得完 and 做完 say the opposite of the English.

q: 奶奶每天早上都___。
zh: 奶奶每天早上都喝一杯牛奶。
py: nǎi nai měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē yī bēi niú nǎi
en: Grandma drinks a glass of milk every morning.
why: A habit with a new counted object ('a glass of milk') is plain SVO. 把 needs a specific object and an outcome, so 把一杯牛奶喝 is wrong.

q: 弟弟把我刚买的新手机___了，我气得说不出话来。
zh: 弟弟把我刚买的新手机弄坏了，我气得说不出话来。
py: dì di bǎ wǒ gāng mǎi de xīn shǒu jī nòng huài le wǒ qì de shuō bu chū huà lái
en: My little brother broke the new phone I'd just bought, and I was too angry to speak.
why: 把 needs the verb plus its result: 弄坏 says what became of the phone. A bare 弄 does not say anything happened to it, and 着 / 过 do not give a result.

q: 我在楼下，请你把伞带___。
zh: 我在楼下，请你把伞带下来。
py: wǒ zài lóu xià qǐng nǐ bǎ sǎn dài xià lái
en: I'm downstairs; please bring the umbrella down to me.
why: The umbrella moves down towards the speaker, so 下来. 下去 would be away from the speaker, and 上来 / 上去 go up. The whole direction stays after the verb.

q: 他把那把椅子搬___了。
zh: 他把那把椅子搬走了。
py: tā bǎ nà bǎ yǐ zi bān zǒu le
en: He carried that chair away.
why: 搬走 puts a direction (away) after the verb, which satisfies 把. 着, 过 and 的 add no direction or result.

q: 孩子把玩具都带___学校去了。
zh: 孩子把玩具都带到学校去了。
py: hái zi bǎ wán jù dōu dài dào xué xiào qù le
en: The child took all the toys to school.
why: 带 + 到 + place marks the destination of a movement. 带在学校 would say where something rests, and 给 / 成 need a person or a new form.

q: 他___把我借给他的钱还给我，我有点儿着急。
zh: 他还没把我借给他的钱还给我，我有点儿着急。
py: tā hái méi bǎ wǒ jiè gěi tā de qián huán gěi wǒ wǒ yǒu diǎn r zháo jí
en: He still hasn't paid back the money I lent him, and I'm a bit anxious.
why: 'Has not yet' is 还没, before 把. 不 would say he refuses, 已经 says he has done it, and 不会 is a prediction. None of these match the worry in the second clause.

q: 这件外套已经不流行了，你把它___，再买一件新的吧。
zh: 这件外套已经不流行了，你把它卖掉，再买一件新的吧。
py: zhè jiàn wài tào yǐ jīng bù liú xíng le nǐ bǎ tā mài diào zài mǎi yī jiàn xīn de ba
en: This coat is out of fashion; sell it and buy a new one.
why: 卖掉 gives the verb a result, which 把 needs. A bare 卖 is not allowed after 把, and 着 / 过 do not fit an instruction.

zh: 我把作业做完了。
py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le
en: I've finished my homework.
why: With 把 the object sits between 把 and the verb, and 做完 stays together with 了 at the end. The object cannot stay after the verb.

zh: 爸爸把桌子搬进去了。
py: bà ba bǎ zhuō zi bān jìn qù le
en: Dad carried the table inside.
why: The object 桌子 goes right after 把, and the verb with its whole direction 搬进去 follows as one block, then 了.

zh: 我把书包放在沙发上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shū bāo fàng zài shā fā shàng le
en: I put my school bag on the sofa.
why: 放在 + place needs the specific object moved forward with 把. 了 may sit after the place or right after 放在, but the bag cannot follow the verb.

zh: 我没把钱带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ qián dài lái
en: I didn't bring the money.
why: 没 goes before 把, and 带来 closes the phrase with no 了. 我把钱没带来 puts the negator in the wrong place.

zh: 别把牛奶洒在地上。
py: bié bǎ niú nǎi sǎ zài dì shàng
en: Don't spill the milk on the floor.
why: 别 stands before 把, then the object, then 洒在 + place. The negative cannot go between the object and the verb.

zh: 你可以把车停在门口。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài mén kǒu
en: You can park the car at the door.
why: The modal 可以 goes before 把, never after the object. 停在门口 stays together as the verb and its destination.

zh: 奶奶把碗洗干净了。
py: nǎi nai bǎ wǎn xǐ gān jìng le
en: Grandma washed the bowls clean.
why: 把 + object comes first, then verb + result 洗干净 kept together, then 了. The result cannot be separated from the verb.

zh: 请把这封信交给爸爸。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi bà ba
en: Please hand this letter to Dad.
why: 交给 + person with a specific object needs 把, and 请 comes first. The letter cannot follow 交给 here.

zh: 我想把房间打扫干净。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng
en: I want to get the room properly clean.
why: 想 is a modal and stands before 把. The verb keeps its result 干净, and there is no 了 because it has not happened yet.

zh: 我把钱包忘在商店里了。
py: wǒ bǎ qián bāo wàng zài shāng diàn lǐ le
en: I left my wallet in the shop.
why: 忘在 + place with a specific object needs 把. The wallet goes before the verb, and 了 can come after the place or after 忘在.

zh: 姐姐把我的自行车骑走了。
py: jiě jie bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
en: My sister rode off on my bike.
why: The possessed object 我的自行车 is specific and goes after 把. 骑走 keeps the verb and direction together, with 了 last.

zh: 哥哥已经把票买好了。
py: gē ge yǐ jīng bǎ piào mǎi hǎo le
en: My older brother has already bought the tickets.
why: The time adverb 已经 goes before 把, not between the object and the verb. 买好 keeps its result, then 了.

zh: 他没把那件衣服退回去。
py: tā méi bǎ nà jiàn yī fu tuì huí qù
en: He didn't take that garment back.
why: 没 goes before 把, and the direction 退回去 stays whole after the verb. After 没 there is no 了.

zh: 请你把这些菜放进冰箱里。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè xiē cài fàng jìn bīng xiāng lǐ
en: Please put these vegetables in the fridge.
why: 放进 + place needs the specific object before the verb with 把. 这些菜 cannot be left after 放进.

zh: 售货员把东西装进袋子里了。
py: shòu huò yuán bǎ dōng xi zhuāng jìn dài zi lǐ le
en: The shop assistant put the things in the bag.
why: 装进 + place moves the goods into the bag, so they go before the verb with 把. 了 may follow the place or 装进.

zh: 妈妈把这笔钱存进了银行。
py: mā ma bǎ zhè bǐ qián cún jìn le yín háng
en: Mum put this sum of money into the bank.
why: The specific sum goes after 把 and before 存进 + destination. 了 can come after 存进 or at the end.

zh: 我们应该把旧衣服送给邻居。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi bǎ jiù yī fu sòng gěi lín jū
en: We should give the old clothes to the neighbour.
why: 应该 is a modal and goes before 把. 送给 + person comes after the object.

zh: 老师把我们当作自己的孩子。
py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ men dàng zuò zì jǐ de hái zi
en: The teacher treats us as her own children.
why: 当作 must be followed straight away by what the object is treated as, so 我们 goes after 把 and in front of the verb.

zh: 妈妈还没把菜洗好。
py: mā ma hái méi bǎ cài xǐ hǎo
en: Mum hasn't finished washing the vegetables yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把, and 洗好 keeps its result. After 没 there is no 了.

zh: 你把价钱再说一遍。
py: nǐ bǎ jià qián zài shuō yī biàn
en: Say the price once more.
why: The verb is not bare because 一遍 follows it. 价钱 goes after 把, and 再说 stays together before the number of times.

zh: 我一直把他当作自己的弟弟。
py: wǒ yī zhí bǎ tā dàng zuò zì jǐ de dì di
en: I've always treated him like my own younger brother.
why: 一直 goes before 把, and 当作 must be followed straight away by what he is treated as. 他 cannot come after the verb.

zh: 爸爸打算把旧房子卖掉，再买一套新的。
py: bà ba dǎ suàn bǎ jiù fáng zi mài diào zài mǎi yī tào xīn de
en: Dad plans to sell the old house and buy a new one.
why: 打算 stands before 把. 卖掉 supplies a result, and the new, counted object 一套新的 stays after its own verb 买 without 把.

zh: 你千万别把发票弄丢了。
py: nǐ qiān wàn bié bǎ fā piào nòng diū le
en: Whatever you do, don't lose the receipt.
why: 千万别 goes before 把, and 弄丢了 keeps the result 丢 attached to the verb. The receipt cannot sit after 弄丢了.

zh: 老板把那些便宜的东西摆在了门口。
py: lǎo bǎn bǎ nà xiē pián yi de dōng xi bǎi zài le mén kǒu
en: The shop owner put those cheap goods at the entrance.
why: 摆在 + place with a specific object needs 把. 了 may come after 摆在 or at the end, but the goods cannot follow the verb.

zh: 妈妈没把我买的东西放进冰箱里。
py: mā ma méi bǎ wǒ mǎi de dōng xi fàng jìn bīng xiāng lǐ
en: Mum didn't put the things I bought into the fridge.
why: 没 goes before 把, and the whole phrase 我买的东西 is the specific object. 放进冰箱里 stays together and takes no 了.

py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi niú nǎi hē wán le

src_py: wǒ bǎ lǐ wù mǎi hǎo le
task: Say 'I have already ...' with 已经.
zh: 我已经把礼物买好了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ lǐ wù mǎi hǎo le
en: I've already bought the presents.
why: 已经 goes before 把, never between the object and the verb. 买好 and 了 stay at the end.

src_py: qǐng bǎ yī fu guà zài mén hòu miàn
task: Say that he did it (他 ... 了).
zh: 他把衣服挂在门后面了。
py: tā bǎ yī fu guà zài mén hòu miàn le
en: He hung the clothes behind the door.
why: The statement keeps 把 + object + 挂在 + place. 了 can come after the place or after 挂在.

src_py: wǒ bǎ nà xiē jiù shū mài le
zh: 我想把那些旧书卖了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ nà xiē jiù shū mài le
en: I want to sell those old books.
why: 想 is a modal and goes before 把. 卖了 can still end the phrase because selling removes the object.

src_py: gē ge bǎ chē jiè gěi le péng you
zh: 哥哥没把车借给朋友。
py: gē ge méi bǎ chē jiè gěi péng you
en: My brother didn't lend the car to a friend.
why: 没 goes before 把 and the 了 is dropped. 借给 + person stays after the object.

src: 弟弟把我的蛋糕吃完了。
src_py: dì di bǎ wǒ de dàn gāo chī wán le
zh: 弟弟吃完了我的蛋糕。
py: dì di chī wán le wǒ de dàn gāo
en: My little brother finished my cake.
why: A specific object with a simple result allows both orders. Without 把 the object follows 吃完了.

src_py: wǒ zuó tiān xǐ le sān jiàn yī fu
task: Now say 'I washed those clothes clean', with 把.
zh: 我把那些衣服洗干净了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà xiē yī fu xǐ gān jìng le
en: I washed those clothes clean.
why: The source has a new counted object after the verb. Once the object is specific (那些衣服) it can go after 把, with the result 干净 and 了.

src_py: wǒ men bǎ jiù diàn shì bān zǒu ba
zh: 我们把旧电视搬走了。
py: wǒ men bǎ jiù diàn shì bān zǒu le
en: We carried the old TV away.
why: Replace the suggestion 吧 with 了 to report it as done. The direction 走 stays with the verb.

src_py: tā bǎ wǒ de míng zi xiě cuò le
zh: 他没把我的名字写错。
py: tā méi bǎ wǒ de míng zi xiě cuò
en: He didn't write my name wrong.
why: 没 goes before 把 and 了 is dropped. The result 错 stays attached to 写.

src_py: wǒ bǎ qián huán gěi tā le
task: Say 'I haven't ... yet' with 还没.
zh: 我还没把钱还给他。
py: wǒ hái méi bǎ qián huán gěi tā
en: I haven't paid him back yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把 and takes no 了. 还给 + person keeps its place after the object.

src: 妈妈把买来的水果切好了。
src_py: mā ma bǎ mǎi lái de shuǐ guǒ qiē hǎo le
task: Turn it into a polite request starting with 请你.
zh: 请你把买来的水果切好。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ mǎi lái de shuǐ guǒ qiē hǎo
en: Please cut up the fruit that was bought.
why: A request keeps 把 + object + verb + result but drops 了, since nothing has happened yet.

src: 我昨天没把那张发票带回家。
src_py: wǒ zuó tiān méi bǎ nà zhāng fā piào dài huí jiā
zh: 别忘了把那张发票带回家。
py: bié wàng le bǎ nà zhāng fā piào dài huí jiā
en: Don't forget to take that receipt home.
why: 别忘了 comes first, then the 把 phrase with its direction 带回家. 没 and 昨天 disappear.

src: 老师把我们的作业都改完了。
src_py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ men de zuò yè dōu gǎi wán le
task: Say it has not happened yet with 还没.
zh: 老师还没把我们的作业都改完。
py: lǎo shī hái méi bǎ wǒ men de zuò yè dōu gǎi wán
en: The teacher hasn't finished marking all our homework yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把, and 都 stays after the object, where it sums it up. 了 is dropped.

src: 他打算把这些旧家具卖给邻居。
src_py: tā dǎ suàn bǎ zhè xiē jiù jiā jù mài gěi lín jū
task: Say it has already happened (已经 ... 了).
zh: 他已经把这些旧家具卖给邻居了。
py: tā yǐ jīng bǎ zhè xiē jiù jiā jù mài gěi lín jū le
en: He has already sold this old furniture to the neighbour.
why: 已经 replaces 打算 and goes before 把. 了 can follow 邻居 or follow 卖给.

src: 你应该把这个价钱告诉妈妈。
src_py: nǐ yīng gāi bǎ zhè ge jià qián gào su mā ma
task: Say 'don't tell Mum' using 不要.
zh: 你不要把这个价钱告诉妈妈。
py: nǐ bù yào bǎ zhè ge jià qián gào su mā ma
en: Don't tell Mum this price.
why: 不要 replaces 应该 and stays before 把.

src: 他们把那个小房间当作书房。
src_py: tā men bǎ nà ge xiǎo fáng jiān dàng zuò shū fáng
task: Say they have always done this (一直).
zh: 他们一直把那个小房间当作书房。
py: tā men yī zhí bǎ nà ge xiǎo fáng jiān dàng zuò shū fáng
en: They have always used that small room as a study.
why: 一直 goes before 把. 当作 stays directly in front of what the room is treated as.

s: 哥哥把那碗饭吃。
s_py: gē ge bǎ nà wǎn fàn chī
zh: 哥哥把那碗饭吃了。
py: gē ge bǎ nà wǎn fàn chī le
en: My older brother ate that bowl of rice.
why: A bare verb is not allowed after 把. 吃 removes the rice, so adding 了 is enough to fix it.

s: 我把这件旧衣服想卖掉。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn jiù yī fu xiǎng mài diào
zh: 我想把这件旧衣服卖掉。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè jiàn jiù yī fu mài diào
en: I want to sell this old coat.
why: The modal 想 goes before 把, not between the object and the verb.

s: 老师翻译这个词成英文了。
s_py: lǎo shī fān yì zhè ge cí chéng yīng wén le
zh: 老师把这个词翻译成英文了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ zhè ge cí fān yì chéng yīng wén le
en: The teacher translated this word into English.
why: 翻译成 must be followed straight away by the new form 英文, so the word translated has to go in front of the verb with 把.

s: 你把书可以放在床上。
s_py: nǐ bǎ shū kě yǐ fàng zài chuáng shàng
zh: 你可以把书放在床上。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ shū fàng zài chuáng shàng
en: You can put the book on the bed.
why: The modal 可以 goes before 把. Between the object and the verb is wrong.

s: 我把这个包很喜欢。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge bāo hěn xǐ huan
zh: 我很喜欢这个包。
py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge bāo
en: I really like this bag.
why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it cannot take 把.

s: 请把拿钱出来。
s_py: qǐng bǎ ná qián chū lái
zh: 请把钱拿出来。
py: qǐng bǎ qián ná chū lái
en: Please take the money out.
why: The object comes directly after 把, and the verb with its whole direction follows. 拿钱出来 cuts the verb away from its object.

s: 妈妈把我看见了。
s_py: mā ma bǎ wǒ kàn jiàn le
zh: 妈妈看见我了。
py: mā ma kàn jiàn wǒ le
en: Mum saw me.
why: 看见 only registers something and does nothing to it, so it takes plain SVO, not 把.

s: 我昨天把一件外套买了。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ yī jiàn wài tào mǎi le
zh: 我昨天买了一件外套。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn wài tào
en: I bought a coat yesterday.
why: 'A coat' is a new, counted object, so it stays after the verb. 把 needs a specific object such as 那件外套.

s: 我把这些衣服洗不干净。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē yī fu xǐ bu gān jìng
zh: 我洗不干净这些衣服。
py: wǒ xǐ bu gān jìng zhè xiē yī fu
en: I can't get these clothes clean.
why: 洗不干净 is a potential complement saying the result cannot be reached, and 把 needs a result that is reached.

s: 你把我的手机能还给我吗？
s_py: nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī néng huán gěi wǒ ma
zh: 你能把我的手机还给我吗？
py: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī huán gěi wǒ ma
en: Can you give my phone back to me?
why: The modal 能 goes before 把, not after the object. 还给 + person then follows the specific object 我的手机.

s: 我把这件事早就知道了。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì zǎo jiù zhī dào le
zh: 我早就知道这件事了。
py: wǒ zǎo jiù zhī dào zhè jiàn shì le
en: I've known about this for ages.
why: 知道 is a mental state, not an action on the object, so it never takes 把.

s: 我把妈妈的话忘了。
zh: 我把妈妈的话忘了。
py: wǒ bǎ mā ma de huà wàng le
en: I forgot what Mum said.
why: 忘 looks like a mental verb, but it is one of the exceptions: the thing is lost, and 了 is enough after 把.

s: 她把那条旧裙子卖了。
zh: 她把那条旧裙子卖了。
py: tā bǎ nà tiáo jiù qún zi mài le
en: She sold that old skirt.
why: 卖 gets rid of the skirt, so 了 alone is a sufficient ending after 把. The skirt is specific (那条).

s: 我把价格看清楚了。
zh: 我把价格看清楚了。
py: wǒ bǎ jià gé kàn qīng chu le
en: I've read the price properly.
why: 看 takes 把 when a real result such as 清楚 follows. Only bare perception like 看见 is excluded.

s: 你把这些旧杂志扔了吧。
zh: 你把这些旧杂志扔了吧。
py: nǐ bǎ zhè xiē jiù zá zhì rēng le ba
en: Throw out these old magazines.
why: 扔 removes the object, so 了 completes the phrase even in a suggestion, and 这些 makes the object specific.

s: 我昨天买了两条围巾。
zh: 我昨天买了两条围巾。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le liǎng tiáo wéi jīn
en: I bought two scarves yesterday.
why: 'Two scarves' is new and counted, so plain SVO is correct. 把 would be wrong here, so the absence of 把 is not an error.

s: 妹妹把我的面包吃了一半。
zh: 妹妹把我的面包吃了一半。
py: mèi mei bǎ wǒ de miàn bāo chī le yī bàn
en: My little sister ate half of my bread.
why: The object 我的面包 is specific, and 一半 after the verb counts as the extra element. 把 is fine.

s: 你不把作业做完，就不能看电视。
zh: 你不把作业做完，就不能看电视。
py: nǐ bù bǎ zuò yè zuò wán jiù bù néng kàn diàn shì
en: If you don't finish your homework, you can't watch TV.
why: 不 before 把 is correct in a condition or attitude like this. Only a past event that did not happen must use 没把.

s: 别把钱包放在口袋里。
zh: 别把钱包放在口袋里。
py: bié bǎ qián bāo fàng zài kǒu dai lǐ
en: Don't put your wallet in your pocket.
why: 别 goes before 把, and 放在 + place completes the phrase. A command like this takes no 了.

s: 我还没把买衣服的钱交给妈妈。
zh: 我还没把买衣服的钱交给妈妈。
py: wǒ hái méi bǎ mǎi yī fu de qián jiāo gěi mā ma
en: I still haven't handed Mum the money for the clothes.
why: 还没 stands before 把, and 交给 + person follows the specific object 买衣服的钱. There is no 了 after 没.
